premises.text: Sundial Foods aims to create plant-based meat products with complex textures using novel processing methods
premises.evidence_span: what we set out to do at Sundial is go back to the basics of plant ingredients and figure out how we could create a novel processing method for actually creating those complex layers of texture that make eating meat so good

premises.text: The first product is called Sundial Wings, which has a crispy skin and meat-like texture
premises.evidence_span: what you just tried is actually the first product we bring to the U.S. market and it's called Sundial Wings

premises.text: The nutritional profile of Sundial Wings is very similar to real chicken
premises.evidence_span: the nutritional profile is very similar to real chicken
